negative_findings.description: Unicorn's sitemap (https://unicorn.com/sitemap.xml, ~168 URLs across root, /en/ and /cs/ prefixes) contains news pages (news-archiv-unicorn-all, news-detail, news-coworkers), company pages (unicorn-group-profile, mission, history), service pages and product pages (Unicorn Universe), but NO dedicated case-study/reference section and NO investor-relations section. Plain fetches of unicorn.com, unicorn.com/cz and the EN news archive returned only the page title because the site is client-side rendered; unicorn.com/cz returned 404 (the Czech prefix is /cs/).
negative_findings.result_summary: Unicorn publishes no public reference or case-study library and no IR section on this domain, and what it does publish is not retrievable without JavaScript execution. unicornsystems.eu 301-redirects to unicorn.com, so it is an alias rather than a second source.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Unicorn is a large Czech software house with known banking delivery, but it is structurally silent about named clients on the open web — so for this actor the vendor-newsroom channel that underpins the whole cell rationale does not function. Coverage of Unicorn's bank work must come from other channels: Sbirka listin filings, procurement records, and trade press. It also warns that sitemap presence, not homepage fetch, is the only reliable change-detection primitive for JS-rendered vendor sites.

negative_findings.description: Four of the cell's relevant domains have migrated and answer only via redirect: www.trask.cz 301 to www.thetrask.com; www.i.cz 301 to www.iczgroup.com; adastra.cz and www.adastragrp.com to adastracorp.com (and /cs/); www.computerworld.cz 301 to www.computertrends.cz. Separately, the bare host systemonline.cz fails TLS certificate validation ('not in the cert's altnames') and only www.systemonline.cz is usable.
negative_findings.result_summary: Legacy domain lists for this cell are stale. All redirects observed were single-hop and well-formed, so the underlying sources are healthy — only the addresses changed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any historical source registry or monitoring config built on the old domains will either fail or silently follow redirects without updating provenance, corrupting the audit trail. The systemonline.cz TLS mismatch in particular produces a hard failure that looks like a dead source but is only a hostname error — always store the www form.

negative_findings.description: An attempt to locate the Czech National Bank's public procurement page at https://www.cnb.cz/cs/o_cnb/verejne-zakazky/ returned HTTP 404. The correct path for the CNB profil zadavatele was not established within this slice, and no CNB procurement URL is asserted.
negative_findings.result_summary: No CNB procurement source recorded. This is a negative finding rather than a guessed URL.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The CNB is both a bank and a contracting authority, so its supplier awards are one of the few fully public records of a Czech bank buying technology — a direct complement to this cell's vendor-side sources. The gap is a missed high-value channel, not a dead end; the correct path needs to be found via the CNB site navigation or the procurement gazette.

negative_findings.description: The session's WebSearch budget (200/200 calls) was already exhausted before this scout issued a single query, so NONE of the assigned seed queries could be run through a search engine. Fallback search endpoints were then attempted and all failed: DuckDuckGo HTML and Lite endpoints served a CAPTCHA challenge ('Select all squares containing a duck'), Mojeek returned HTTP 403, and Bing's RSS output endpoint (bing.com/search?...&format=rss) returned cache-collided results unrelated to the query — a query for '"Diebold Nixdorf" "Czech Republic" bank ATM press release' returned ten Italian-language Lionel Messi quiz pages, and vendor-name queries returned only navigational homepage results with the long-tail terms silently dropped.
negative_findings.result_summary: All discovery in this slice was therefore done by first-principles reasoning about source categories, direct URL navigation to vendor domains, redirect-chain following, and ON-SITE search endpoints (which did work — Temenos site search returned the Czech evidence). Recall is consequently structurally biased toward vendors whose domains could be guessed and away from long-tail or unexpected actors.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This slice should be treated as high-precision but incomplete recall. A re-run of this cell with a working search budget is likely to add materially new candidates, particularly smaller vendors and Czech-language items that only a search index would surface.

negative_findings.description: Czech-language keyword search through a search engine — the mandatory cs-language leg of the method — could not be executed for the same budget reason. The Czech seed query 'Diebold Nixdorf NCR Atleos tisková zpráva Česká republika banka bankomaty' was never run. Czech-language coverage in this slice was instead achieved by navigating directly to Czech-language sources and reading them in Czech (protext.cz, bankovnictvionline.cz, systemonline.cz, lupa.cz) and by building the cs glossary from first principles.
negative_findings.result_summary: Three Czech-language sources were verified live and are included as candidates (ČTK Protext finance and IT categories, Bankovnictví online, IT Systems/SystemOnLine). Czech terms actually used against live sites: tisková zpráva, tiskové zprávy, bankomat, finance a ekonomika, IT komunikace a elektronika, vyhledávání, zprávy, banky a finance, banky a finanční organizace, přehledy, technologie, regulace, komerční přílohy, Komerční banka, Česká republika. Terms built but NOT yet exercised against any index: platební terminál, jádrový bankovní systém, samoobslužná zóna, recyklace hotovosti, výroční zpráva, případová studie, nasazení, implementace, dodavatel.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Czech-language discovery is present but shallow. Any Czech-language vendor announcement that lives outside these three portals is currently invisible to this cell.

negative_findings.description: No Czech-language edition of any global banking-technology vendor site in this cell was located. https://www.dieboldnixdorf.com/cs-cz returned HTTP 500. Comarch's finance news section explicitly offers EN/PL/DE/FR/IT/ES/PT and no Czech option, and www.comarch.cz resolved to a parked domain (certificate issued for parking.domeny.tv). Printec's Czech entry point could not be established: printecgroup.com paths returned 403 and https://www.printec.cz/ failed TLS validation with a self-signed certificate.
negative_findings.result_summary: Working hypothesis for this cell: the global vendors publish Czech-relevant material in English only, and any Czech-language version reaches the market through the ČTK Protext wire or Czech trade press rather than through a vendor-owned .cz property. This is exactly the language asymmetry the cell rationale predicted.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the collection design: monitor global vendor newsrooms in EN, and monitor Czech-language pickup separately via Protext and the trade press. Do not expect a vendor-owned Czech newsroom to exist.

negative_findings.description: Two vendor case-study libraries were read in full and neither contains a Czech customer. Diebold Nixdorf's banking case studies currently list Bankart, IPAK YULI Bank (Uzbekistan), GHS Federal Credit Union, Cooperative Bank of Kielce (Poland), America First Credit Union, Banca Raiffeisen Locarno (Switzerland) and JN Bank. NCR Atleos's Customer Stories are almost entirely US credit unions with Santander UK as the only European entry.
negative_findings.result_summary: By contrast Temenos does carry a Czech reference (Komerční banka, both a selection release and a go-live release plus a success story). So the Czech reference asymmetry across vendors is real and measurable.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is a genuine competitor-positioning finding, not just an absence: on their own public evidence, Temenos has a marquee Czech core-banking reference while Diebold Nixdorf and NCR Atleos publicise none. It also means the case-study libraries are worth monitoring as tripwires rather than as current sources of Czech content.

negative_findings.description: A consistent WAF/bot-defence pattern blocked six otherwise-central sources from this fetcher: Finastra press-media (403 on three path variants), Printec Group (403 on three paths), Asseco Central Europe at ce.asseco.com (403), Finextra retail-banking channel (403), SEC EDGAR full-text and browse-edgar endpoints (403, User-Agent policy), and Fiserv newsroom (two 60s timeouts). Thales Group's corporate press-release page returned an empty document body on two path variants, consistent with client-side rendering or a consent gate.
negative_findings.result_summary: NONE of these is recorded as dead. 403-with-no-body and repeated timeouts are the signature of edge bot rules, and in SEC's case the 403 is documented policy for clients that do not declare a contact User-Agent. Euronet is a separate case: a 301 from euronetworldwide.com/news to euronet.com/news that itself 404s indicates a site migration, i.e. moved.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The collection layer for this cell must be provisioned with a headless browser and realistic headers, plus a compliant declaring User-Agent for SEC. Without that, roughly a third of the cell's highest-value sources will look permanently unavailable when they are merely defended.

negative_findings.description: Lupa.cz was fetched and assessed as a candidate Czech-language channel and deliberately NOT included. It is a Czech internet/technology portal whose visible content on the day of assessment covered AI, healthcare digitisation, cloud infrastructure, 3D printing and quantum computing, with no banking IT, fintech or payments coverage in evidence, and no RSS link visible.
negative_findings.result_summary: Rejected for this cell on relevance grounds rather than reachability. Bankovnictví online and SystemOnLine cover the same country with far higher banking-technology density.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Documents a deliberate exclusion so a later run does not re-litigate it, and keeps the candidate list precision-weighted rather than padded.

negative_findings.description: NCR Atleos's own investor newsroom carries the release 'Shareholders Overwhelmingly Vote to Approve Brink's Acquisition of NCR Atleos' dated 30 June 2026, alongside Q2 2026 results dated 5 August 2026.
negative_findings.result_summary: The investor.ncratleos.com domain, its RSS feed and its numeric /detail/<id>/ archive are all at material risk of retirement or redirection into Brink's investor infrastructure once the transaction closes.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is the single best-automatable endpoint in the cell (real RSS, stable IDs). If it is not mirrored before close, the historical ATM-vendor announcement archive for CEE could become materially harder to reconstruct, and a live monitor would silently go quiet rather than error.

negative_findings.description: The WebSearch tool returned 'this session has used its web search budget (200 of 200 WebSearch calls)' on the very first query attempt, so no search-engine query — Czech or English — could be executed during this cell.
negative_findings.result_summary: All discovery was performed instead by direct HTTP fetch of candidate association domains, robots.txt/sitemap.xml enumeration, and recursive link-graph snowballing. This worked well for the six named associations (all six located and mapped) but eliminated the long-tail discovery path that would surface smaller or newer associations whose domains cannot be guessed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Coverage of the six seeded associations is thorough and evidence-backed, but the cell cannot claim completeness for Czech financial-sector associations generally. Any association without a guessable domain and without an inbound link from the ones crawled is invisible to this pass.

negative_findings.description: The Czech Fintech Association's official press release category at https://czechfintech.cz/category/tiskove-zpravy/ appears abandoned.
negative_findings.result_summary: The newest items retrieved are dated Kvě (May) 2022 and Bře (March) 2022 — the latter announcing Miroslav Lukeš and Ondřej Machač taking over the association's leadership. Meanwhile the same site's /clanky/ stream carries items dated 14-20 August 2026, so the site is live; only this category is dormant.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Anyone monitoring ČEFTAS via the obvious 'tiskové zprávy' URL would wrongly conclude the association is inactive, and would miss four years of activity. Monitoring must target /clanky/ and /udalosti/ instead, or the WordPress /feed/.

negative_findings.description: Member rosters at three of the six target associations are not present in server-rendered HTML.
negative_findings.result_summary: ČLFA /o-nas/clenske-spolecnosti returned 9,253 bytes of navigation and breadcrumb with zero company names; czechfintech.cz /clenove/ returned 274,188 bytes containing the headings 'Řádní členové' and 'Přidružení členové' but no member names (logo-image rendering); AKAT /Clenove-asociace returned 37,722 bytes with the same headings and no names. By contrast ČBA /o-nas/clenove and APEK /seznam-clenu rendered their full rosters in plain HTML.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Three of the cell's most valuable enumerations require headless-browser collection rather than simple HTTP, which changes the cost and fragility profile of the collection pipeline. The ČEFTAS case may have a cheaper workaround via its exposed WordPress REST API at /wp-json/wp/v2/.

negative_findings.description: ČBA's robots.txt disallows the storage path that appears to hold its annual report PDFs.
negative_findings.result_summary: https://www.cbaonline.cz/robots.txt contains 'Disallow: /api/', 'Disallow: /cba_online/' and 'Disallow: /journal_files_storage/'. The /o-nas/vyrocni-zpravy index renders 16 dated rows (2011 through 2026-05-26) with 'Zobrazit PDF' controls, but a static fetch of that page yielded no .pdf hrefs at all — the links are injected client-side and resolve into the disallowed storage area.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Automated harvesting of ČBA annual reports would breach the site's stated crawler policy. The compliant routes are manual retrieval, or a direct request to the ČBA press office. This is a policy constraint, not a technical one, and should be flagged to whoever configures the collector.

negative_findings.description: ČBA's main site is largely client-rendered, hiding most of its content from plain HTTP clients.
negative_findings.result_summary: https://www.cbaonline.cz/ returned 55,021 bytes but only 7 navigable links, and topic pages such as /stranky/pro-media, /stranky/pruzkumy-a-indexy and /stranky/prognozy returned nothing but the page title and nav chrome. Two independent WebFetch attempts on the homepage and /o-nas both reported that member, annual-report and press-release links were absent. The content was only recoverable via robots.txt -> sitemap.xml, which exposed 2,838 URLs including all 28 structural /stranky/ and /o-nas/ pages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A naive crawler would grade ČBA — the single most important association in this cell — as a near-empty site. The sitemap-first approach should be the documented default for this domain, and is a transferable technique for other JS-heavy Czech association sites.

negative_findings.description: Česká asociace pojišťoven (cap.cz) could not be fetched.
negative_findings.result_summary: curl returned error 56 'Recv failure: Connection reset by peer' with HTTP code 000 — the connection was reset mid-response rather than refused or 404'd.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This pattern is characteristic of bot defence (TLS-fingerprint or user-agent filtering) on a live site, not of a dead host. Per the run's hard rules this is recorded as a hypothesis requiring the deterministic verification pass; it must not be marked dead. ČAP matters because bancassurance is a material fee-income line for Czech banks.

negative_findings.description: AKAT's 'Monitoring trhu' section is dormant despite the rest of the site being current.
negative_findings.result_summary: The newest item on https://www.akatcr.cz/Asociace-AKAT/Monitoring-trhu is a February 2019 TV interview with Jana Brodani about mutual fund investing. AKAT's press release and annual report sections are by contrast current to August 2026.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The section name promises exactly what a market-intelligence collector wants and delivers seven-year-old content. The live equivalents are /Zverejnena-data and /Dokumenty/Tiskova-zprava-AKAT; the collector configuration should skip Monitoring trhu.

negative_findings.description: APEK states two different member counts on two of its own properties.
negative_findings.result_summary: https://www.apek.cz/seznam-clenu states 'Celkem je vylistováno 570 členů' across 64 pages, while https://data.apek.cz/ describes APEK as a 'sdružení více než 650 podnikatelů' (association of more than 650 entrepreneurs).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The figures differ by roughly 14 percent. Either the data site is stale, or the directory excludes some membership class. Any headline citing APEK membership size must state which source and date it came from; the directory count is the defensible one because it is enumerable.

negative_findings.description: No Czech crypto-asset or digital-asset industry association was located in this cell.
negative_findings.result_summary: With WebSearch unavailable, no crypto-industry association domain could be discovered, and none of the six seeded associations linked to one. The nearest observed signal was editorial coverage of a euro stablecoin on the ČEFTAS /clanky/ stream — topical interest without an identified representative body.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: MiCA implementation makes crypto-asset service providers a live competitive and regulatory topic for Czech banks and payment firms. If a Czech CASP association exists, it is an unmapped pointer source. No URL is asserted here because none was found — guessing one would be fabrication.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Czech association of non-bank payment institutions or payment service providers was identified.
negative_findings.result_summary: Non-bank acquirers and PSPs do appear in Czech industry data — SBK's statistics contributor list names ComGate Payments, EVO Payments, Global Payments, Nexi, Euronet, KB Smart Pay, Twisto Payments and Direct Fidoo Payments — but they surface as data contributors to SBK, not as members of any PSP-specific trade body found in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: It is plausible that no such Czech association exists and that SBK plus ČEFTAS jointly occupy that representational space. That is itself a useful structural finding: for Czech non-bank payments actors, SBK's contributor roster is the best available enumeration and should be treated as the primary registry for that segment.

negative_findings.description: Two collection-relevant encoding and URL hazards were observed that will silently corrupt a naive collector.
negative_findings.result_summary: First, the SBK and CardMag sites are legacy hand-built pages served in a Czech single-byte encoding — extracted text loses all diacritics under a UTF-8 assumption ('Sdružení' rendered as 'Sdruen', 'platebních karet' as 'platebnch karet'). Second, AKAT's DNN platform encodes Czech characters as decimal HTML entities inside URL slugs, e.g. '/Dokumenty/Vyrocni-zpravy/v253rocn237-zpr225va-20232024' for 'výroční zpráva'. Third, several SBK homepage hrefs are malformed, missing the slash after the host (e.g. 'http://aktuality.bankovnikarty.czTZ_MasterCard_18-08-2026.pdf').
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Each hazard produces silent failures rather than errors: mangled Czech entity names that will not match any actor map, unmatched URL patterns, and 'dead link' false positives on SBK that are actually authoring typos. All three need explicit handling in the collector.

negative_findings.description: The WebSearch tool was unavailable for this entire slice: the first search call returned 'this session has used its web search budget (200 of 200 WebSearch calls)'. Both attempted Czech-language queries ('ČTK Protext tisková zpráva distribuce banka platební služby' and 'Protext ČTK distribuce tiskových zpráv ceník archiv') were refused before execution.
negative_findings.result_summary: No SERP-based discovery was possible. All 30+ sources below were found instead by direct fetch of known/inferred Czech domains and by link-snowballing homepages, footers and category pages. Czech-language coverage was still achieved (all navigation, terms and paths used were Czech), but a cs-language search sweep of the seed queries has not been performed and this slice should not be treated as a completed cs-search pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Long-tail actors that have no guessable domain — small payment institutions, credit unions (spořitelní a úvěrní družstva), niche fintechs, PR agencies with financial clients — are exactly the ones a search sweep would surface and a domain-guessing sweep will miss. The cell's stated rationale (catching entities too small to have discoverable IR sections) is therefore only partly served.

negative_findings.description: financninoviny.cz, historically ČTK's dedicated economic/financial news domain, no longer serves its own site.
negative_findings.result_summary: https://www.financninoviny.cz/ returns HTTP 301 Moved Permanently to http://www.ceskenoviny.cz/ekonomika/.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any stored source registry entry or historical citation pointing at financninoviny.cz should be remapped to ceskenoviny.cz/ekonomika/. The economic wire has been folded into the general ČTK consumer site rather than discontinued.

negative_findings.description: No public entry point to ČTK's Infobanka news archive could be located.
negative_findings.result_summary: https://www.ctk.cz/sluzby/infobanka/ returned HTTP 404, and ibsearch.ctk.cz did not resolve at all (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND). Infobanka is named as a service on https://www.ctk.cz/sluzby/ but the product page path is different from the obvious guess.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Infobanka is the deep historical archive of Czech agency reporting and the natural back-catalogue for banking and payments announcements older than the free web archive. Access will require going through ČTK commercially (ctk@ctk.cz, +420 222 098 111) rather than finding a public URL.

negative_findings.description: csob.cz refuses automated fetches across every path attempted.
negative_findings.result_summary: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error on /portal/csob/pro-media, /portal/o-csob/pro-media and /pro-media. A 500 rather than a 404 indicates the host answered and withheld content — consistent with edge bot defence, not with a missing page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: ČSOB is one of the largest Czech banking and payments groups; leaving it uncollected would be a material gap. Recorded as blocked-but-live, not dead. Interim workarounds: the ČTK Protext wire and the KBC Group newsroom.

negative_findings.description: Several financial-sector hosts returned WAF-style 403s to this fetcher.
negative_findings.result_summary: HTTP 403 Forbidden on https://www.unicreditbank.cz/, https://www.creditas.cz/ and https://www.mastercard.com/news/europe/cs-cz/. All three are near-certainly live sites behind bot filtering.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These are hypotheses about accessibility, not verdicts about liveness. They should be routed to a browser-based collector rather than marked dead, and their newsroom paths remain unconfirmed — no path was invented for them here.

negative_findings.description: Two Czech media-monitoring vendors could not be reached because of TLS errors from this environment.
negative_findings.result_summary: https://www.anopress.cz/ failed with 'certificate has expired'; https://www.monitora.cz/ failed with 'self signed certificate'. Both errors occurred before any HTTP response, so nothing is known about the sites' content or liveness.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These are the main alternatives to NEWTON Media for retrospective archives of Czech coverage. The identical class of failure across two unrelated hosts suggests a local TLS-interception artefact rather than two simultaneous vendor outages, so they must be re-verified rather than dropped.

negative_findings.description: globalpaymentseurope.eu no longer presents a valid certificate for its own name.
negative_findings.result_summary: Fetch failed with 'Hostname/IP does not match certificate's altnames: Host: www.globalpaymentseurope.eu is not in the cert's altnames: DNS:0oo1.cz, DNS:www.0oo1.cz' — the hostname now resolves to infrastructure serving an unrelated domain.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Global Payments Europe was a significant Czech card-processing actor. The certificate mismatch is evidence that the web presence has been retired, rebranded or absorbed, which means its announcement channel needs to be re-identified under whatever the current corporate name is. Recorded as an unresolved lead, not as a dead company.

negative_findings.description: Three financial companies exposed no media section from their homepage navigation.
negative_findings.result_summary: visa.cz homepage showed no 'tiskové zprávy', 'pro média' or newsroom links at all. jtbank.cz (J&T Banka) exposed only contacts, wealth report and investment-services links. partnersbanka.cz exposed only /o-nas, /pobocky and /kontakty. In each case the homepage was fetched successfully — the links are genuinely absent from it, though a section may exist deeper in the site.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is precisely the pattern the cell exists to handle: where no corporate newsroom is discoverable, the ČTK Protext wire and the media-monitoring archives become the only systematic capture route for that actor. For Visa specifically, Czech announcements appear to run through the global newsroom or through partner releases — a Visa Czech Top Shop item was observed on the Protext finance feed, issued by a third party (INSTORE CONSULTING EU), not by Visa.

negative_findings.description: The 'obvious' Czech newsroom path /o-nas/pro-media or /o-bance/pro-media is unreliable across the sector.
negative_findings.result_summary: 404s were returned by moneta.cz/o-nas/pro-media (real path: /servis-pro-media/tiskove-zpravy), rb.cz/o-nas/pro-media (real path: /informacni-servis/pro-media), airbank.cz/o-air-bank/pro-media/ (real path: /pro-novinare/) and cbaonline.cz/tiskove-zpravy (association 404 page). fio.cz/o-nas/pro-media resolved to the homepage rather than a newsroom (real path: /spolecnost-fio/media/tiskove-zpravy). Only kb.cz and csas.cz matched the guessed pattern.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any collector built on a path template will silently lose most of the sector, and stored registry URLs will rot. Newsroom URLs must be resolved per-entity from homepage navigation and re-resolved periodically. The local vocabulary is broader than 'pro média': 'pro novináře', 'servis pro média', 'informační servis', 'tiskové centrum' and plain 'média' all occur.

negative_findings.description: Machine-readable feeds are largely missing from Czech bank newsrooms.
negative_findings.result_summary: No RSS feed was visible on the media sections of Komerční banka, MONETA, mBank CZ or Air Bank. RSS was confirmed only for Česká národní banka (footer link /cs/obecne/rss/) and for ceskenoviny.cz (footer RSS link). MONETA and the Prague Stock Exchange offer email newsletters instead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection for this cell will be poll-and-diff HTML crawling rather than feed subscription for most corporate newsrooms, which raises both latency and fragility. It also strengthens the case for treating the ČTK wire as the primary rail: one crawlable, paginated, searchable archive covering many actors at once.

negative_findings.description: Several newsroom listing pages returned navigation-only shells to a plain HTTP fetch.
negative_findings.result_summary: kb.cz/cs/o-bance/tiskove-zpravy, csas.cz/cs/o-nas/pro-media/tiskove-zpravy, rb.cz/informacni-servis/pro-media/tiskove-zpravy and cbaonline.cz/stranky/pro-media all returned headers and menus with no release items, despite HTTP 200. Items were visible on the parent /pro-media pages for KB and ČS.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These are client-rendered listings, not empty archives. A headless browser is required for collection; a naive crawler would record these high-value banks as having zero press releases.

negative_findings.description: No Czech-language competitor to ČTK Protext was identified in this run.
negative_findings.result_summary: Protext (ČTK) and NEWTON Media's PR Studio are the only Czech press-release distribution products confirmed by fetch. No second national wire was found, and without WebSearch it was not possible to test for smaller or defunct distributors, so no local-language terms for such competitors could be gathered.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If Protext is effectively the single national wire, the collection design has a single point of failure and a single point of leverage. That conclusion is plausible from what was observed but is not established — it rests on absence of evidence produced by a tool constraint, not on a completed search.

negative_findings.description: The session's WebSearch budget (200/200 calls) was already exhausted by earlier agents before this scout issued its first query. Both attempted seed queries — 'Hospodářské noviny banka hospodářské výsledky zisk čtvrtletí' (cs) and 'Seznam Zprávy Aktuálně banky výsledky platby analýza' (cs) — were refused by the tool with a budget message, and no further cs or en search-engine queries could be run.
negative_findings.result_summary: Zero search-engine results obtained. Discovery was carried out entirely by direct fetching of candidate domains and by snowballing section trees, publisher names and RSS paths out of the fetched navigation of each site.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Search-engine discovery is how you find the outlets you did not already think of — smaller CZ business titles, journalist blogs, newsletter products, tag pages for individual banks. This slice is therefore strong on the named backbone outlets and structurally verified section URLs, but weaker on long-tail discovery than a normal run. A re-run with search budget should be scheduled before this cell is considered complete.

negative_findings.description: Both MAFRA-group domains named in the cell brief — ekonomika.idnes.cz and www.lidovky.cz — were refused by the fetch tool itself with 'Claude Code is unable to fetch from <host>'. This is a client-side domain block, not a server response.
negative_findings.result_summary: No structural verification of iDNES Ekonomika or Lidovky Ekonomika: section paths, RSS feeds and paywall model remain unconfirmed. Both are recorded as candidates with blocked=true and reduced confidence, NOT as dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: iDNES is one of the highest-reach Czech news portals and Lidovky is a quality daily; missing their feed structure leaves a hole in mass-reach amplification signal. A browser-based pass (Chrome MCP) or a plain HTTP client outside this tool should recover them cheaply.

negative_findings.description: Four further hosts failed on transport or bot-defence grounds: monitora.cz and www.monitora.cz ('self signed certificate'), www.anopress.cz ('certificate has expired'), www.denik.cz/ekonomika/ (HTTP 403), english.radio.cz (HTTP 403).
negative_findings.result_summary: None of these could be structurally verified. Per the playbook, 403s and TLS failures are treated as bot-defended-or-environment issues, i.e. hypotheses, not liveness verdicts.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Two of them (Monitora, Anopress) are aggregator/archive routes that would materially reduce the cost and legal risk of collecting paywalled CZ coverage, so they are worth re-testing rather than dropping.

negative_findings.description: Several guessed section URLs did not resolve: seznamzpravy.cz/sekce/ekonomika-11 returned the World desk rather than economics (correct IDs are ekonomika-194 and ekonomika-finance-299, recovered from the homepage nav); denikn.cz/rubrika/byznys/ 404'd (correct path /ekonomika/ plus tag pages); info.cz/ekonomika 404'd; echo24.cz/ekonomika 404'd; newtonmedia.eu/cs 404'd; forbes.cz/rubrika/byznys/ 301-redirected to a 2014 CDN image file.
negative_findings.result_summary: Section IDs and paths in the Czech mainstream media are not guessable and several are stale; all confirmed paths in this slice were taken from fetched navigation, not assumed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any crawler for this cell must resolve section URLs from live navigation at build time and re-validate them periodically, otherwise feeds will silently go empty after a site relaunch. The Forbes case shows a redirect can point at a legacy asset and still return 301, which naive crawlers will treat as success.

negative_findings.description: Apart from E15's explicit 'Finance a bankovnictví' section, no outlet in this cell was confirmed to expose a standing banking-only landing page. HN uses byznys.hn.cz, Seznam Zprávy uses a general Finance sub-desk, Aktuálně and ČT24 use a general Ekonomika rubric.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bank-specific filtering will mostly have to be done downstream by keyword, not by subscribing to a beat feed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Drives collection design: expect a low signal-to-noise ratio on general economy feeds and budget for a Czech-language keyword/entity filter (bank names in all inflected forms plus 'zisk', 'výsledky', 'platební', 'poplatky').

negative_findings.description: The most analytically valuable titles in this cell are the most closed: Ekonom returned a hard subscription wall ('Pro tento web nemáte aktivní předplatné'), HN gates premium behind HN+ and sells print PDFs at 40 Kč per issue, Deník N is freemium-paywalled, E15 has an e15 Premium tier.
negative_findings.result_summary: Free open access in this cell is concentrated in Aktuálně.cz, Seznam Zprávy, Novinky.cz, ČT24, ČeskéNoviny.cz/ČTK, Euro.cz and CzechCrunch.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collection plan that relies only on open sources will systematically capture wire copy and consumer-facing amplification while missing the executive comment and unpublished figures that are the stated reason this cell exists. Budget for 3-4 subscription seats or a Newton/Monitora licence.

negative_findings.description: Local-language (cs) working terms were used throughout — byznys, ekonomika, finance a bankovnictví, zisk, hospodářské výsledky, čtvrtletí, tisková zpráva, předplatné, rubrika, sekce, vydání, archiv, monitoring médií, pobočka, bankomat, hotovost, dobírka, úrokové sazby, ČNB — and cs terms in fetched pages were used to confirm section identity. However, because the search tool was unavailable, these terms were applied to site navigation and listing pages rather than to search queries.
negative_findings.result_summary: Local-language verification was achieved at the site level (Czech section names, Czech paywall strings, Czech article headlines read on-page), but not at the query level.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The mandatory local-language requirement is only partially satisfied: cs was used for reading and classification but no cs search query returned results. This must be closed on a re-run.

negative_findings.description: No parent group in this cell publishes a Czech-language investor-relations channel. Searches in Czech for group results returned only (a) subsidiary press rooms relaying the group release, and (b) Czech financial media. Erste, KBC, SG, UniCredit, RBI and BNP Paribas all report in English (plus German/Dutch/French for their home markets).
negative_findings.result_summary: Zero parent-group IR pages found in Czech. The only cs-language primary artefacts in this cell are Erste releases republished on csas.cz, Czech-language prospectuses on rb.cz and ppfbanka.cz, and pse.cz issuer pages for the dual-listed Erste Group Bank AG.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any collection design that keys on Czech-language discovery will systematically miss this entire channel. Conversely, cs-language terms are still needed to find the relay layer and the Czech-law prospectus documents, so a bilingual crawl is mandatory rather than optional.

negative_findings.description: BNP Paribas group reporting appears to no longer carry a Czech retail-banking segment. Hello bank! by Cetelem (launched in CZ in November 2017) closed Czech current and savings accounts in 2023 and transferred its active loan book to Česká spořitelna.
negative_findings.result_summary: No BNP Paribas Personal Finance Czech standalone results or segment disclosure located. Remaining Czech presence found is Cardif pojišťovna, Arval, Leasing Solutions, Securities Services and a corporate/institutional banking branch — visible only as entity-list entries, not as a reported segment.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: BNP Paribas should be de-prioritised relative to the other five parents in this cell; tracking it at URD-annex frequency (annual) is sufficient, and expecting quarterly Czech banking data from it would waste collection budget.

negative_findings.description: UniCredit's 'Financial Reports from our Countries' index returned HTTP 403 Forbidden on direct fetch. The same host serves /content/dam/ PDF assets that were referenced successfully from search results.
negative_findings.result_summary: 403 with no response body, 2026-08-25. Treated as a bot/WAF defence hypothesis, not as a dead or removed page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic verification pass should retry this with browser-class headers before any liveness verdict; recording it as dead would wrongly remove the group-maintained pointer to UniCredit Bank Czech Republic and Slovakia's statutory reporting.

negative_findings.description: Two guessed hub URLs failed: societegenerale.com/en/analysts-investors returned 404 and rbinternational.com/en/raiffeisen/about-us/our-network/international-network.html returned 404.
negative_findings.result_summary: SG's IR content actually lives on a separate host, investors.societegenerale.com, which was located and fetched successfully. For RBI, no HTML index page for the country sheets was found — only the direct PDF asset under /content/dam/.../country-sheets-2025/.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that hub URLs must be discovered from search or site navigation, never constructed. It also means RBI country-sheet editions have no discoverable index and will need year-segment probing or site-search to detect new releases.

negative_findings.description: Erste Group's Capital Markets Days page yielded only a link to CMD2019; no recent capital-markets-day deck for the current strategy cycle was located, despite the cell rationale specifically naming CMD decks as a source of Czech digital-investment plans.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recent strategy content (2030 ambition, five pillars, CZ retail loan share 27.0% / deposit share 27.5%) was found instead inside the quarterly results decks and third-party slide summaries, not in a CMD deck.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Strategy-level Czech numbers currently have to be mined from quarterly presentations rather than from a dedicated CMD artefact. The CMD page should still be watched, but it cannot be the primary route to digital-investment and branch-plan data today.

negative_findings.description: For the ATM/self-service hardware and services parents (Diebold Nixdorf, NCR Atleos, Nexi), no Czech-specific disclosure was found in group financial reporting.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only marketing artefacts surfaced — e.g. a Diebold Nixdorf customer case study on end-to-end ATM network outsourcing for ČSOB (99.8% uptime, 99.98% cash availability). Nexi produced no Czech-specific hit at all.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: For these vendors the useful group-level channel is case studies and press releases, not segment reporting. They belong in a vendor/supplier cell rather than in parent-group investor reporting, and should not be tracked here at earnings cadence.

negative_findings.description: Société Générale publishes no Czech- or Komerční banka-specific investor deck. KB is folded into the international retail banking / mobility and financial services reporting line.
negative_findings.result_summary: No SG 'Czech Republic' segment slide located. The recoverable KB-level detail sits in the quarterly financial series Excel supplement and the URD's country-by-country annex, not in a dedicated presentation.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets realistic expectations: for SG, extraction must target Excel supplements and URD annexes. Searching for a KB deck that does not exist would burn effort; SG's KB detail is also thinner than Erste's or KBC's Czech disclosure.

negative_findings.description: The WebSearch tool was unavailable for this entire cell: the very first search call returned 'this session has used its web search budget (200 of 200 WebSearch calls)'. Not one of the six seed queries, in Czech or English, could be executed, and no query-driven discovery or result-page snowballing (including the instructed 'look past the first page of results') was possible.
negative_findings.result_summary: Zero WebSearch queries executed. All 23 candidates were found by direct WebFetch of hypothesised URLs derived from the seed cell text, from Czech-language term-and-domain construction (e.g. 'bankovni poplatky' -> bankovnipoplatky.com, 'sazebniky' -> kurzy.cz/banky/sazebniky/), from first-principles source-category inference, and from on-page snowballing through fetched navigation, publisher families and branding.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Coverage of this cell is biased toward outlets discoverable by name or by predictable Czech URL construction. Smaller regional outlets, newsletters, Substack-style independents, YouTube/podcast-first banking commentators and any outlet whose name could not be guessed are systematically under-represented. The cell should be re-run once search budget is restored; the seed queries remain unused and are still worth executing verbatim.

negative_findings.description: Penize.cz - explicitly named in the coverage cell - could not be inspected. HTTP 403 Forbidden with no response body on both https://www.penize.cz/ and https://www.penize.cz/bezne-ucty. Its sister title https://finmag.penize.cz/ returned an identical 403.
negative_findings.result_summary: Three fetches across two hostnames on the same publisher infrastructure, all 403. Consistent with an edge WAF or bot filter, not with a dead or moved site (a dead host would refuse the connection; a moved one would 404).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: One of the two anchor portals in this cell is undocumented. Its comparison tables, fee coverage and company-data sections are unmapped, so any completeness claim for the Czech consumer-finance comparison layer is currently false. Per the run's hard rules this is a hypothesis of bot defence, NOT a liveness verdict.

negative_findings.description: Attempted to verify the 'Zlaty mesec' award, which the Czech consumer-finance press associates with Mesec.cz, at https://www.zlatymesec.cz/. The connection was refused outright: ECONNREFUSED 195.250.144.110:443.
negative_findings.result_summary: No HTTP response at all - the host resolved to 195.250.144.110 but refused the TLS connection. Distinct from the 403 and 404 patterns seen elsewhere in this run. The award may have been folded into mesec.cz itself, retired, or the site may serve on HTTP only or be temporarily down.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If the award still runs it is a second longitudinal Czech bank-ranking panel alongside Banka roku and Zlata koruna. It should be re-probed (http:// as well as https://, and a site-scoped search of mesec.cz) before being written off - a single refused connection is not proof the award is dead.

negative_findings.description: Investujeme.cz's dedicated banking section at https://www.investujeme.cz/bankovnictvi/ rendered a single article dated 2022-09-20, about banking and insurance recruitment and salary levels, with no product, fee, ATM-network or executive coverage.
negative_findings.result_summary: The banking taxonomy node is either abandoned or the live banking coverage has moved to a path not discoverable without search. Homepage-level banking and mortgage coverage does appear current.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector pointed at /bankovnictvi/ would silently return nothing for years and look like a healthy but quiet feed. The active path must be re-mapped before this source is wired up.

negative_findings.description: Mesec.cz's own homepage navigation advertised a section path '/bankovni-ucty/', but https://www.mesec.cz/bankovni-ucty/ returned HTTP 404 Not Found. The working structure is https://www.mesec.cz/produkty/ with children /produkty/osobni-ucty/, /produkty/podnikatelske-ucty/, /produkty/sporici-ucty/, /produkty/kreditni-karty-pro-obcany/, /produkty/charge-karty/, /produkty/terminovane-vklady/, /produkty/stavebni-sporeni/.
negative_findings.result_summary: Nav-label-derived paths are unreliable on this site; the /produkty/ hub is authoritative and was verified to render a live fee comparison table.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Records a concrete URL-construction trap for the highest-value source in this cell, so the collector build does not lose time to it and does not misread the 404 as the source being dead.

negative_findings.description: Kurzy.cz banking verticals (/banky/, /banky/sazebniky/, /bankomaty/) returned only the site header, publisher identification (Kurzy.cz, spol. s r.o. and AliaWeb, spol. s r.o.), navigation, and a user-authentication message. No section body was returned on any of the three fetches. No 404 and no 403 was raised.
negative_findings.result_summary: Three fetches, three empty bodies with HTTP success. Hypothesis: client-side rendering, or a registration gate, or aggressive markup stripping in conversion - not a dead section.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A potential fourth independent normalisation of Czech bank sazebnik and ATM data is unassessed. If it renders under a headless browser it is a valuable cross-check; if it is login-gated it should be dropped in favour of the banks' own sazebnik PDFs. It must not be recorded as dead.

negative_findings.description: Two outlets whose names implied strong fit turned out to under-deliver on this cell's topics on inspection. FinTag.cz, despite the fintech-suggestive name, published general economics and politics (US debt, Ukraine, pharma) rather than Czech retail-bank product or fee detail. Lupa.cz, the Internet Info technology title, showed no dedicated banking, payments or fintech coverage on its homepage at all.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both are recorded as low-priority candidates with the shortfall documented rather than dropped, so a future run does not re-discover them and re-inflate expectations from the name alone.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents wasted collector capacity and stops name-based optimism from inflating the apparent density of the Czech specialist-media layer.

negative_findings.description: Local-language (cs) coverage was achieved despite the search outage: every candidate but none-excepted was fetched at a Czech-language property, and Czech domain terms were used constructively to locate sources - 'bankovni poplatky' produced bankovnipoplatky.com/.cz, 'sazebniky' and 'bankomaty' produced the Kurzy.cz vertical paths, 'banky' produced banky.cz, and 'poradci sobe' produced the adviser community. The Czech glossary actually exercised includes: sazebnik, poplatky, vedeni uctu, vyber z bankomatu, vyber na prepazce, osobni/bezny ucet, podnikatelsky ucet, sporici ucet, terminovany vklad, stavebni sporeni, kreditni/charge karta, hypoteka, RPSN, urokova sazba, repo sazba CNB, bezkontaktni platba, platebni terminal, bankovni identita/BankID, zebricky, srovnani, rozhovory, personalie, regulace, predplatne.
negative_findings.result_summary: No topic in this cell had to be pursued in English only. English-language search was, however, not performed at all because of the budget outage, so the en-language half of the mandate is unfulfilled.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Satisfies the mandatory local-language requirement on the cs side and records exactly which Czech terms proved productive, so the re-run can start from a working glossary. It also flags honestly that the en-language leg is missing, not merely thin.

negative_findings.description: WebSearch was unavailable for the entire run: the first two search calls (the Czech-language seeds 'CzechCrunch fintech investice platby startup kolo financování' and 'Lupa.cz platební technologie banka fintech') both returned 'this session has used its web search budget (200 of 200 WebSearch calls)'. No search engine query — Czech or English — could be executed at any point.
negative_findings.result_summary: All discovery in this slice was done by direct HTTP fetch of hypothesised or snowballed URLs, plus one on-site search (cc.cz/?s=fintech). Roughly 30 URLs were fetched. Czech-language coverage was still achieved — Czech terms were used against on-site search and Czech tag paths (/n/fintech/, /n/platby/, /n/bankovnictvi/, /tag/fintech/) — but no engine-mediated Czech-language discovery took place.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Direct fetching only finds sources you can already guess the domain of. Small Czech fintech blogs, personal Substack-style newsletters, LinkedIn-native commentators and independent podcasts are exactly the long-tail this cell was scoped to catch, and they are effectively invisible without a search engine. The slice is therefore biased toward large, well-known outlets and should be re-run once the search budget is restored.

negative_findings.description: CzechCrunch does not appear to expose a dedicated fintech tag or topic archive. https://cc.cz/tema/fintech/ returned homepage-style content rather than a tag archive (a soft 404), and the confirmed rubric list from the homepage (/byznys/, /startupy/, /tech/, /investice/, /e-commerce/, /krypto/, /umela-inteligence/ and others) contains no fintech rubric.
negative_findings.result_summary: No /tema/fintech/ or /fintech/ archive could be confirmed. On-site search at https://cc.cz/?s=fintech works and returns 38 results with /page/N/?s= pagination, and is the recommended substitute.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collection design that assumes a stable CzechCrunch fintech tag URL will silently collect nothing. Monitoring must instead combine the /live/ wire, the /byznys/ + /startupy/ + /investice/ rubrics, and repeated keyword searches.

negative_findings.description: https://cc.cz/eventy/fintech-week-cee-2026/ appeared in CzechCrunch on-site search results for 'fintech', but fetching it returned the general CzechCrunch events index (People, Money Maker Praha, Longevity Festival 2027, Future 2027, CzechCrunch X, plus supported events) with no Fintech Week CEE content at all.
negative_findings.result_summary: Fintech Week CEE 2026 could not be confirmed as a CzechCrunch-hosted event page; no organiser, date, venue, speaker or partner list was obtained. The URL is recorded as unverified, not dead — search results referencing it suggest it existed at some point.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Fintech Week CEE would be a strong pointer source (organiser, sponsor and speaker lists are a ready-made actor map for CEE payments). It should be re-chased directly on its own domain once search is available, rather than through CzechCrunch.

negative_findings.description: https://ceftas.visualbook.pro/, linked from the Czech Fintech Association's projects page, was hypothesised to be a fintech company map or directory. It is not — it is the association's brand and visual identity guidebook (logos, typography, colours, naming conventions, contact ondra@czechfintech.cz), available in Czech, Slovak and English.
negative_findings.result_summary: No fintech company map, catalogue or landscape graphic was found on the association's site. The usable actor lists are the member directory at /clenove/ (80+ members) and the CzechTrade export brochure at /project/10647/ (200+ active firms).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a downstream collector from wasting effort parsing a brand style guide as a company database, and redirects effort to the two lists that actually contain company names.

negative_findings.description: A 'FinTech Roadmap' podcast was hypothesised as a Czech Fintech Association partnership and specifically searched for on both https://czechfintech.cz/clanky/ and https://czechfintech.cz/projekty/. Neither page mentions it. The association's confirmed projects are the Studie českého fintechu, the Enterprise Investment Scheme (EIS) initiative, and the CzechTrade export brochure.
negative_findings.result_summary: No association-run podcast confirmed. More broadly, no dedicated Czech-language fintech-only podcast was verified anywhere in this run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell brief explicitly names 'fintech-focused blogs and podcasts' as a target. The podcasts actually confirmed are general-business (CzechCrunch Money Maker, 201 eps), general-tech (Lupa.cz podcast), and adjacent HN shows (MoneyPenny on personal finance, Krypto Insider on crypto). The dedicated Czech fintech podcast layer is currently an unfilled gap, not a covered one.

negative_findings.description: The StartupJobs.cz magazine path https://www.startupjobs.cz/magazin returned HTTP 404. The blog at https://www.startupjobs.cz/blog does exist and is live, but its content is HR-focused — hiring, interviews, compensation, workplace culture, monthly labour-market notes (e.g. /blog/clanek/co-cervenec-posunul-vpred-7-26).
negative_findings.result_summary: No coverage of Czech startup funding rounds, capital raises or company launches was found on the StartupJobs blog. It does not belong in a funding/launch monitoring pipeline.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: StartupJobs is a plausible-looking startup-ecosystem property that would waste a collection slot. Its residual value is as a hiring-signal source (a payments startup posting many roles is a growth signal), which is a different workstream from A1.

negative_findings.description: SMARTmania.cz (Czech consumer tech portal, founded 2005, redakce@smartmania.cz) was probed as a possible mobile-payments channel (Apple Pay, Google Pay, banking apps). The retrieved homepage showed only smartphones, smartwatches, keyboards, drones and automotive content, with categories under /kategorie/recenze/ and a product catalogue at /katalog/.
negative_findings.result_summary: No evidence of payments, banking-app or Czech bank launch coverage was found. Registration-gated perks exist but no paywall or RSS was visible.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Rules out one of the obvious consumer-tech candidates for wallet/contactless coverage and narrows where that signal actually lives — Lupa.cz /n/platby/ carried the contactless-wearables story (Huawei watches, 13.4.2026) instead.

negative_findings.description: Five plausible Czech sources returned HTTP 403 Forbidden with no response body on a single plain fetch each: https://www.penize.cz/, https://www.investicniweb.cz/, https://www.zive.cz/, https://www.ecommercebridge.cz/ and https://finmag.cz/. A 403 with no body is the signature of bot protection, not of a dead site.
negative_findings.result_summary: All five are recorded as blocked=true and unverified rather than dead. Four are carried as candidates with reduced confidence (0.30-0.35); Finmag.cz is recorded here only, as nothing at all about its current structure could be confirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If these are logged as dead, the run permanently loses the merchant-acceptance angle (Ecommerce Bridge) and two significant consumer-finance archives. They must be re-probed with a headless browser or realistic headers before any liveness verdict is issued.

negative_findings.description: Two domains failed below the HTTP layer rather than returning a status code: https://tyinternety.cz/ failed with 'connect ECONNREFUSED 167.99.132.26:443' (DNS resolved, TLS connection refused), and https://depo.ventures/ failed with 'getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND depo.ventures' (no DNS record at all).
negative_findings.result_summary: TyInternety.cz — a Czech digital/marketing trade title — could not be assessed. Depo Ventures, hypothesised as a publisher of a Czech startup funding report, has no resolving domain under that name; the Czech startup funding report hypothesis is unconfirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: ENOTFOUND is materially stronger evidence than a 403 — the depo.ventures guess was almost certainly just a wrong domain, so the Czech VC-published funding-report layer remains entirely unexplored. TyInternety needs one retry before any conclusion; a single ECONNREFUSED can be transient or geo/IP-specific.

negative_findings.description: Forbes Česko (forbes.cz) — an outlet named explicitly in this coverage cell — returned essentially empty bodies on three separate paths: the homepage, /technologie/ and /tag/fintech/. Each returned only a title/header line ('Forbes | I jedna věta vám může změnit život!', and for the tag page 'Fintech ▶ ... s Forbes Česko | Forbes'), with no navigation, no article list and no URLs.
negative_findings.result_summary: Confirmed: HTTP 200 responses and a /tag/<slug>/ URL pattern with a fintech tag that resolves. Unconfirmed: rubric structure, article inventory, paywall model, newsletters, podcasts, RSS.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Forbes CZ is a named target of this cell and cannot be collected with a plain HTTP client. Any pipeline must budget for headless rendering, or find a sitemap/RSS bypass, before Forbes coverage can be claimed.

negative_findings.description: The glossary used in this run was assembled ad hoc from observed page navigation rather than from a systematic Czech terminology build, because no search engine was available to test term productivity. Terms actually exercised: fintech, fintechové startupy, platby, platební brána, platební metody, bezkontaktní platby, bankovnictví, banky, účty a platby, kreditní/charge karty, startupy, investice, kolo financování, evidence tržeb/EET, sandbox, tiskové zprávy, členové, rozhovor, podcast.
negative_findings.result_summary: Several important Czech terms were never exercised against any index: 'platební instituce', 'poskytovatel platebních služeb', 'licence ČNB', 'akvizice', 'akvirer', 'terminál', 'POS terminál', 'mobilní peněženka', 'okamžité platby', 'PSD2', 'otevřené bankovnictví'.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Noisy-vs-productive term classification is unvalidated. 'Platby' in particular is high-recall but noisy (it surfaced Apple subscription revenue and a DDoS story alongside genuine payments-infrastructure news), while 'platební instituce' and 'licence ČNB' are likely high-precision and were never tested. The glossary must be rebuilt and tested when search is restored.

negative_findings.description: WebSearch was unavailable for the entire slice: the very first search call returned 'this session has used its web search budget (200 of 200 WebSearch calls)'. No cs-language or en-language query-based discovery could be executed at all.
negative_findings.result_summary: Zero search queries ran. Discovery was reconstructed entirely from direct WebFetch of the cell's named seed actors plus link-snowballing through their navigation, which recovered ~21 candidates but cannot surface actors that were not already named or linked.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The seed queries explicitly instructed extension beyond the named actors, and mandatory local-language search could not be performed as a search. Any Czech sell-side house, rating-aggregator portal or broker-note archive not linked from patria.cz / kurzy.cz / akcie.cz / roklen24.cz / wood.com / esma.europa.eu is systematically invisible in this slice.

negative_findings.description: Czech-language coverage was achieved through Czech-language page content and Czech navigation terms (doporučení, cílová cena, oficiální sdělení, výsledková sezóna, hospodaření), but NOT through Czech-language search queries, because WebSearch was unusable.
negative_findings.result_summary: Czech terminology was harvested and applied against fetched pages, confirming real cs-language research artefacts (e.g. Patria ratings in Czech: Držet / Redukovat; Akcie.cz 'cílová cena 1043 Kč'). However no cs query such as 'analytická zpráva české banky doporučení cílová cena' was ever submitted to a search engine.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Local-language search is a hard requirement of the method. Czech-only actors — regional broker blogs, Czech-language rating commentary, smaller analyst newsletters — would normally be found by cs queries and are likely under-represented here.

negative_findings.description: All three major rating agencies were unreachable by plain fetch. Moody's (ratings.moodys.com) and S&P Global Ratings (spglobal.com/ratings/en/) both returned HTTP 403 Forbidden with no body; Fitch (www.fitchratings.com) was blocked at the fetch layer before any HTTP status was obtained.
negative_findings.result_summary: Three of the highest-value sources in this cell are recorded as blocked-but-presumed-live. None is recorded as dead — a 403 on a major commercial site is a bot-defence signature, not evidence of absence.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Rating actions are the single most informative third-party interrogation of a bank's disclosures. If the collector cannot reach them, the cell loses its highest-credibility layer and falls back on Czech broker portals alone.

negative_findings.description: Attempts to locate ESMA's European Rating Platform (ERP) — the free, official EU database of individual credit ratings issued by registered CRAs — failed on hostname guesses errp.esma.europa.eu and cerep.esma.europa.eu (both ENOTFOUND) and on the path guess /publications-and-data/european-rating-platform (404). The ESMA CRA supervision hub was reached but does not link the ERP or CEREP.
negative_findings.result_summary: The ERP is not recorded as a candidate URL because no real URL for it was observed. Only the confirmed ESMA CRA hub is recorded, as a pointer.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The ERP would be a free, licence-clean, machine-readable substitute for the three bot-defended commercial agency portals — potentially resolving the highest-severity access problem in this cell. Leaving it unresolved is the biggest unrealised win here.

negative_findings.description: Roklen24, named in the cell brief as a sell-side/analyst-adjacent source, was confirmed live but has narrowed to FX education, currency-pair commentary and an economic calendar. The fetch explicitly found no bank ratings and no traditional analyst research.
negative_findings.result_summary: Roklen24 retained at low priority and usefulness 0.3 rather than being carried at the seed's implied weight.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents the collection pipeline from spending crawl budget and analyst attention on a source that no longer produces the content type this cell needs. The seed list is partially stale and should be corrected upstream.

negative_findings.description: Kurzy.cz per-issuer pages could not be reached. Fetches of https://www.kurzy.cz/akcie-cz/ and https://www.kurzy.cz/akcie-cz/burza/ both returned only global site navigation and the operator notice, with no issuer table and no links for Komerční banka, Moneta or Erste.
negative_findings.result_summary: Kurzy.cz is recorded as a candidate at reduced confidence (0.55) with blocked=true and a javascript_rendering_required blocker, rather than with concrete per-bank URLs.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Kurzy.cz is one of the four aggregators named in the cell brief and is valued specifically for its durable searchable archive. Without resolved per-issuer URLs its archive value cannot be exercised by a simple HTTP collector.

negative_findings.description: The mandatory Czech-language (cs) search leg of this cell was not executed. The session's shared WebSearch budget (200/200 calls) was already exhausted by other agents before this agent issued its first query, so zero searches - English or Czech - could be run. All findings below and all candidates above were produced by direct URL fetching and on-site navigation/snowballing instead.
negative_findings.result_summary: 0 WebSearch queries executed; 0 Czech-language queries; ~25 direct fetches performed instead. The Czech seed query 'zahranicni media o ceskych bankach anglicky zprava akvizice' was never run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The bilingual requirement is unmet for this cell. Czech-language pointer sources - Czech articles citing or summarising foreign coverage, Czech press-release wires, Czech media-monitoring listings - would have snowballed into international outlets that direct-fetching cannot surface. Discovery here is biased toward outlets already named in the cell brief plus what could be inferred from first principles.

negative_findings.description: Kafkadesk (kafkadesk.org), previously an English-language Visegrad/Central Europe news site that would have fit this cell, no longer serves Central European news. The fetched root returned content about Norwegian online casinos.
negative_findings.result_summary: kafkadesk.org root fetch succeeded but returned unrelated gambling-affiliate content; /category/czech-republic/ returned 404.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a stale entry being added to the source registry, and flags that any historical Kafkadesk URLs already held elsewhere in the registry are now unsafe to re-fetch or cite.

negative_findings.description: The two most authoritative sources in this cell - Reuters and Bloomberg - could not be inspected. Reuters and thebanker.com were refused at the fetch-tool layer ('unable to fetch from this domain'); Bloomberg returned HTTP 403 with Retry-After: 0.
negative_findings.result_summary: reuters.com: tool-level domain block. thebanker.com: tool-level domain block. bloomberg.com: HTTP 403 bot defence.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: No section URLs, feed paths or paywall specifics could be confirmed for the highest-credibility English sources on Czech banking. These are access hypotheses to resolve, not evidence that anything is unavailable - all three are certainly live. Practically, all three will need licensed access rather than collection.

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom feed URL was exposed in the fetched markup for Expats.cz, Prague Morning, Emerging Europe, Retail Banker International or bne IntelliNews. Only Finextra published an explicit feed path (/rss/rss.aspx); The Paypers and Global Finance reference feeds/newsletters without a confirmed URL.
negative_findings.result_summary: 1 of ~8 candidate outlets exposed a confirmed feed URL; the rest will require HTML listing polling or feed-path probing.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection cost for this cell is higher than a news-cell normally implies: most sources need scheduled HTML listing polls with entity filtering rather than cheap feed subscriptions, and several are WordPress sites where standard feed paths should be probed before writing scrapers.

negative_findings.description: PYMNTS, one of the largest English payments publications, showed no Czech-focused articles on the first page of its own 'Czech' search; results skewed EU-wide and Poland-centric.
negative_findings.result_summary: On-site search returned 48 pages of nominal matches but no Czech-specific headline in the visible results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets realistic expectations: the global payments trade press treats the Czech market as incidental. Czech payments signal is more likely to come from Finextra company updates, The Paypers M&A items and Czech-language sources than from the large US-centric payments outlets.

negative_findings.description: Several plausible section paths guessed from site conventions returned 404 and were corrected against each site's own navigation: expats.cz Business & Money is /czech-news/economy (not /section/business-money or /business); Prague Morning economics is /category/news/politics-economics/ (not /category/business/); Finextra has no query-string search endpoint at /search or /newssearch; ctk.eu has no /services/foreign_service/ page.
negative_findings.result_summary: 4 guessed paths 404'd and were replaced with navigation-derived URLs; 1 (Finextra search) has no query-string equivalent at all.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Documents that the URLs recorded for these candidates were read from site navigation rather than assumed, and warns the collection layer not to construct section URLs by convention for these domains.

negative_findings.description: Part Five of Decree 163/2014 Sb. and its Annexes 10 and 13 — the provisions that created the standardized quarterly 'Povinně uveřejňované informace' set — were repealed with effect from 1 July 2025. The ČNB's own bank link-index now dates the decree basis as valid only 'until 30.6.2025' and states that institutions may continue disclosing voluntarily under the Banking Act, while prudential disclosure is being centralised at the EBA under CRR Art. 434/434a.
negative_findings.result_summary: The legal compulsion behind this cell has ended. Empirically, publication has NOT stopped: MONETA (2Q 2026), PPF banka (30.6.2026), Fio (H1 2026), ČEB (30.6.2026), Citfin (30.6.2026), Artesa (31.3.2026), RSTS (mid-2026) all continued past the repeal. But continuation is now voluntary, so uniformity and comparability are at risk of eroding institution by institution, silently.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell rationale ('Czech law forces each credit institution to publish…') is now historically true rather than currently true. Collection design must add a drift monitor: per-institution detection of a missed quarter, a changed file layout, or a dropped annex, plus a parallel track on the EBA Pillar 3 Data Hub as the successor. The 2011-2025 archive should be mirrored now, while it is still online.

negative_findings.description: The ČNB master index of bank disclosure URLs contains multiple entries that no longer resolve as published. Observed: PPF banka (404, site migrated to /cs/dokumenty/), Česká exportní banka (404, path restructured), ČSOB Stavební spořitelna listed as cmss.cz (HTTPS connection refused; entity rebranded onto csobstavebni.cz), Buřinka listed as burinka.cz (301 to burinka.csas.cz), Raiffeisen stavební spořitelna (301 into /dokumenty/), MONETA (301 to investors.moneta.cz), Modrá pyramida (TLS certificate now presents kb.cz), Hypoteční banka listed under the retired hypotecnibanka.cz although the entity trades as ČSOB Hypoteční banka on csobhypotecni.cz, and Max banka listed although it ceased to exist on 1.10.2024.
negative_findings.result_summary: Roughly a third of the regulator's own deep links are stale in some way. All were recovered or diagnosed via the recovery ladder; none were confirmed genuinely dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The authoritative index cannot be treated as ground truth for URLs — only for the entity list. Any collector must resolve redirects, follow renames and re-derive deep links from each institution's own navigation, and should re-run that resolution on a schedule.

negative_findings.description: Automated fetches were refused by several of the largest institutions' disclosure pages: ČSOB (HTTP 500 on both the ČNB-listed /portal/... path and the live /csob/... path), ČSOB Hypoteční banka (500), UniCredit Bank CZ&SK (403), Banka CREDITAS (403), ČSOB Stavební spořitelna successor domain (500). All of these URLs are simultaneously search-indexed with live titles.
negative_findings.result_summary: Treated as bot defence, not as dead pages. No liveness verdict is asserted here.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The four systemically important banks are disproportionately represented among the blocked endpoints, so a naive HTTP collector would silently lose the most important half of the sector. Collection for this cell needs a real-browser tier from the outset.

negative_findings.description: Česká spořitelna and Air Bank both bury the statutory disclosure set behind a client-side-rendered document hub. csas.cz/cs/dokumenty-ke-stazeni returns only a header and a loading placeholder to a plain fetch; the disclosure category is reachable only via the SPA fragment #/7/Povinne-informace-v-souladu-s-Vyhlas. airbank.cz/dokumenty-ke-stazeni exposes the tab label 'Povinně uveřejňované informace' but not the file list.
negative_findings.result_summary: Sources are live and open but not harvestable by plain HTTP; no file URLs were obtained for either institution.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Two of the largest retail banks in the country are affected. Also means URL-verification of the fragment form may report a false pass (the shell loads fine while the content is absent).

negative_findings.description: Terminology in this cell is not standardized despite the template being standardized. Observed variants across institutions: 'povinně uveřejňované informace' (majority), 'povinně zveřejňované informace' (Trinity Bank, Česká exportní banka, J&T IS), 'povinné údaje o bance' (UniCredit), 'informace o bance' (KB), 'údaje uveřejňované čtvrtletně' (PPF banka), 'informace dle vyhlášky ČNB' (ČMSS), 'informační povinnost' (J&T, MONETA legacy), 'veřejné informace' (Artesa, NEY), 'povinné informace' (Peněžní dům, Akcenta), 'hospodářské výsledky' (Fio), 'výsledky hospodaření' (Raiffeisenbank), 'dokumenty ke stažení' (Air Bank, Partners Banka, Česká spořitelna). Separately, 'informační povinnost' is a high-noise term because it also denotes issuer disclosure under the Capital Markets Act and reporting duties TOWARD the ČNB.
negative_findings.result_summary: No single search string finds the cell. The uveřejňovaný/zveřejňovaný alternation alone splits results roughly in two.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any keyword-driven rediscovery or site-search fallback must run the full variant set, including the zveřejňované spelling, or it will systematically miss a subset of institutions. Disambiguate 'informační povinnost' with 'banka' plus 'čtvrtletní' or 'vyhláška'.

negative_findings.description: Three ČNB link-indexes discovered on the informační-povinnosti hub were not expanded within this slice: investment companies (prehledu-odkazu-...-is-...), pension companies (...penzijnich-spolecnosti...), and the full 35-row securities-dealer list (only the first 10 rows were retrieved). The EBA Pillar 3 Data Hub public portal was also not enumerated.
negative_findings.result_summary: Pointer pages identified and their URLs captured, but their member lists were not harvested.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The securities-dealer list in particular contains payments/FX actors (AKCENTA CZ, Citfin - Finanční trhy) that belong in the payments half of this run; the remaining 25 rows are unexamined. The P3DH enumeration determines whether the whole per-bank scraping estate can eventually be retired.

negative_findings.description: Wüstenrot hypoteční banka a.s. appears as a regulated subsidiary with its own results section on MONETA's investor site, but was not present in the ČNB bank disclosure link-index retrieved for this slice. Conversely, EEA-passported branches operating in Czechia (mBank S.A., Citibank Europe plc, ING Bank N.V., BNP Paribas, Deutsche Bank, Oberbank AG) are absent by design, since the Czech disclosure duty covers only banks and third-country branches.
negative_findings.result_summary: One possible index omission found; the EEA-branch absence is a genuine scope boundary, not an omission.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The regulator's index is the seed list, so an omission propagates into a permanent blind spot. It also means a material slice of the Czech market (the EEA branches) is structurally invisible in this cell and must be covered from home-country or group disclosures in another cell.

negative_findings.description: The session's web-search budget (200 calls) was exhausted before two planned local-language queries could run: MONETA Stavební Spořitelna's own disclosure deep link, and a direct query for the ČNB securities-dealer link-index. Both were partly recovered by direct fetches instead, but no dedicated local-language search was run for the building-society tier as a whole (e.g. 'stavební spořitelna povinně uveřejňované informace čtvrtletní údaje') or for the 'povinně zveřejňované informace' spelling variant.
negative_findings.result_summary: Coverage of banks and credit unions is thorough; the building-society tier and the spelling-variant sweep are thinner than intended.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A follow-up pass should run the variant-spelling and building-society queries specifically, since the glossary finding above shows that spelling alone partitions the result space.

negative_findings.description: No actual disclosure file (XLSX/ZIP) was opened in this slice — only the index pages listing them. Claims about which fields the template carries (capital and capital adequacy, ownership, organisational chart, branch and staff counts) rest on the decree's description of Annex 10 plus the field lists published on the Artesa and NEY pages, not on inspection of a parsed file.
negative_findings.result_summary: Field-level structure is inferred, not verified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Before a parser is built, at least one XLSX per institution class (large bank, small bank, third-country branch, building society, credit union) should be opened to confirm that the annex layouts really are identical across issuers and stable across the 2014/2017/2021 decree amendments.

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom feed or documented API for BCPP issuer announcements was found. The /novinky and /en/news pages expose only a JS-rendered search UI (source filter PSE vs ČTK, keyword with AND/OR and Czech diacritics, From/To date range) and the Press Centre page advertises no feed either — only the @prazskaburza X/Twitter account as a push channel.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched and fetched pse.cz/novinky, pse.cz/en/news and pse.cz/en/press; no feed URL surfaced in the rendered content or the navigation. This is a not-found, not a proof of absence — an undocumented JSON listing endpoint very likely backs the search UI and should be found by inspecting network traffic in a real browser.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection of the exchange announcement channel will need JS rendering or endpoint reverse-engineering rather than a cheap feed poll, which raises cost and fragility for the single most time-sensitive source in this cell.
